about_the_game:
Seasons of Solitude is a turn-based survival strategy roguelike set in a prehistoric world. Explore handcrafted hex-based maps, endure harsh seasonal changes, and master a deep resource economy where every decision can be your salvation—or downfall. Build shelters, unlock tools, and adapt your strategy across a campaign of escalating challenges.

Explore the Unknown: Reveal the world tile by tile as you move through forests and sun-scorched grasslands. Each discovery may hide resources, threats, or new paths forward. But the world shifts with the seasons—what was safe may not stay that way.

Survive and Strategize: Forage, collect water, and gather materials while tracking your hunger, thirst, and action points. Every action drains you. Every misstep has a cost. Balance short-term needs with long-term survival.

Secure What Matters: Only resources stored at your camp are safe. Push deeper into the wild for rarer materials—or return early to lock in your progress. The farther you go, the more you risk. But the greater the reward.

Evolve Through Tools: Progress unlocks powerful tools that open new strategies and actions in future levels. Recover from near-fatal conditions, adapt to tougher environments, and turn survival into control. Your growth is permanent—even when your run ends.

Plan Ahead or Perish: Each level presents unique objectives and hazards that challenge your adaptability. Will you build for the future, or fight to make it through the day? Strategy, not luck, determines your survival.

Key Features

  • Hex-Based Tactical Survival:
    Every action costs points. Every tile matters. Plan your moves carefully as you balance exploration, survival, and progression.

  • Dynamic Biomes & Seasonal Shifts:
    Each environment reacts to the changing seasons—altering resource yields, movement costs, and hazard behavior. Adapt your tactics as the landscape transforms.

  • Tool Unlock System & Meta-Progression:
    Secure rare resources to craft powerful tools that unlock new actions across future runs. Your growth is permanent—even if your run isn’t.

  • Risk-Reward Resource Economy:
    What you carry is vulnerable. What you store in camp is safe. Will you push deeper or return to secure your survival?

  • Handcrafted Levels, Strategic Depth:
    No randomness for the sake of difficulty. Each map is carefully designed to test specific skills—resource routing, hazard handling, tool usage, and more.

A World Where Solitude Tests Your Limits
You stand alone. No tribe, no second chances—only your decisions shape your survival. Explore, adapt, and endure. Seasons of Solitude challenges you to master the wild, one turn at a time.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
